_README: Hand-verified ground truth for calibration (ABSENCE_BRIEF.md Section 11). Each label is a judgement about whether the SOURCE DOCUMENT satisfies the item's hypothesis as written -- not whether the company discloses the thing anywhere, and not whether the detector found it. Established by reading the surrounding text, not by keyword matching: five separate ground-truth errors in this project came from matching a keyword without checking context (see MILESTONE1_RESULTS.md and PER_METRIC.md). Where a label is marked null the cell was not verified and must be excluded from any metric.

_method.assurance_provider_named: Requires a NAMED third-party firm assuring reported emissions/environmental data. Chevron and Goldman describe assurance but name no firm for emissions data (Goldman's PwC letter covers green-bond proceeds allocation, explicitly 'no assurance on allocations in excess of net proceeds'). Alphabet says 'third-party-verified LCAs' without naming a firm.
_method.scope1_absolute: Requires absolute Scope 1 in tonnes CO2e. Microsoft reports only percentage changes (absolute figures live in a separate Environmental Data Fact Sheet); Chevron reports intensity (kg CO2e/boe); ExxonMobil's executive summary carries no emissions table.
_method.target_net_zero_year: Requires a stated target year for net zero / carbon neutrality. All ten state one.
_method.board_committee_climate_mandate: Requires a SPECIFIC named board committee with climate oversight. Chevron says 'The Board also oversees ... climate and sustainability matters' -- the board generally, not a named committee. Goldman's 'Firmwide Climate Steering Group' is a management body, not a board committee.
_method.scope3_category_breakdown: Requires Scope 3 split into named GHG Protocol categories. Verified by requiring category names within 300 characters of a 'Scope 3' mention, or 'Category N:' formatting -- an unconstrained keyword search wrongly counted ordinary uses of 'investments' and 'business travel'.
_method.scenario_analysis_quantified: Requires a monetary impact figure derived from climate scenario analysis. No company in this corpus has one: six discuss scenario analysis, none attach a dollar amount to its results.
_method.injury_rate_trir: Requires a numeric injury rate. ExxonMobil discloses '0.02 LTIR ... lost-time incident rate per 200,000 work hours' -- an equivalent statistic the hypothesis explicitly admits.
